known_conflicts_with_original_V6: TRANSFER no colocation in frozen V6
WAIT old effect only defers, new atomic time update
extra external transfer request fluent not in original V6
RETAIN prior version may reduce protection, new candidate disallows

policy_decisions.ACTION_COST: For reachability categories choose all shortest feasible plans by number of actions ≤3 with no lexical tiebreak. For goal_persistence use pure hold-through-T2 safety and optional *explicit goal of stationary item location*; enumerate ALL successful one-step interventions, never choose one by desired horizon.
policy_decisions.ACTIVATE: OFF→ON, immediately fire linked trigger if present, no hidden causal link.
policy_decisions.CARRY: Target unheld at actor location OR already held by actor; actor moves to a different location and all items held by actor follow. Frozen V6 precondition only unheld: material amendment.
policy_decisions.EXOGENOUS: At most one request (at∈{T1,T2,NONE}, item, recipient), processed only during atomic WAIT tick; require holder, nonself, unprotected, colocated; if blocked it stays blocked (no rescheduling). This fluent is not in the original frozen V6 AM01 state fluents.
policy_decisions.GENESIS: T0 intrinsic assigned holders allowed if co-located with their item, all power OFF, triggers false, no defer, schedules only future T1/T2/NONE, no exogenous request at T0. Initial-state axiom only, not historical predecessor proof.
policy_decisions.PRIORITY: Scheduled trigger first, then exogenous transfer request, protection guard wins at equal time. CARRY relocates all held items atomically.
policy_decisions.RELOCATE: Only unheld item at a0 current location; destination different; change item location only.
policy_decisions.RETAIN: Actor currently holds target; time horizon must strictly increase protected_until, horizon >=current_time; inclusive protection through horizon; no minimal-horizon cost or label-conditioned tiebreak. Frozen V6 uses set, not monotone max: material amendment.
policy_decisions.TRANSFER: Require holder=a0, recipient=a1, same agent location and strict expired protection. Move item only to co-located recipient. Frozen V6 has no co-location check: material amendment.
policy_decisions.WAIT: Must target pending scheduled trigger in future; atomic advance all intermediate clock ticks in order; fire scheduled triggers then exogenous request, with protection guard ahead of transfer; clear defer_until on arrival. Frozen V6 lacks explicit advance in original AM01 effect: material amendment.
